verses.en: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
verses.pt: Moças: Para onde foi o teu amado, ó tu mais bela entre as mulheres? Para que direção se virou o teu amado, para o procurarmos contigo?
verses.en_web: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?
verses.en_bbe: Where is your loved one gone, O most fair among women? Where is your loved one turned away, that we may go looking for him with you?

verses.en: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
verses.pt: Ela: Meu amado desceu ao seu jardim, aos canteiros de especiarias, para apascentar seu rebanho nos jardins, e para colher lírios.
verses.en_web: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to take food in the gardens, and to get lilies.

verses.en: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.pt: Eu sou do meu amado, e meu amado é meu; ele apascenta entre os lírios.
verses.en_web: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies,
verses.en_bbe: I am for my loved one, and my loved one is for me; he takes food among the lilies.

verses.en: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.
verses.pt: Ele: Tu és bela, minha querida, como Tirza, agradável como Jerusalém; és formidável como bandeiras de exércitos.
verses.en_web: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.
verses.en_bbe: You are beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, as fair as Jerusalem; you are to be feared like an army with flags.

verses.en: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
verses.pt: Afasta teus olhos de mim, pois eles me deixam desconcertado. Teu cabelo é como um rebanho de cabras, que descem de Gileade.
verses.en_web: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be turned away from me; see, they have overcome me; your hair is as a flock of goats which take their rest on the side of Gilead.

verses.en: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
verses.pt: Teus dentes são como um rebanho de ovelhas, que sobem do lavatório; todas produzem gêmeos, e não há estéril entre elas.
verses.en_web: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing; of which every one has twins; no one is bereaved among them.
verses.en_bbe: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep which come up from the washing; every one has two lambs, and there is not one without young.

verses.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
verses.pt: Como um pedaço de romã, assim são as laterais de teu rosto abaixo de teu véu.
verses.en_web: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.en_bbe: Like pomegranate fruit are the sides of your head under your veil.

verses.en: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.pt: Sessenta são as rainhas, e oitenta as concubinas; e as donzelas são inúmeras;
verses.en_web: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.en_bbe: There are sixty queens, and eighty servant-wives, and young girls without number.

verses.en: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
verses.pt: Porém uma é a minha pomba, minha perfeita, a única de sua mãe, a mais querida daquela que a gerou. As moças a viram, e a chamaram de bem-aventurada; as rainhas e as concubinas a elogiaram.
verses.en_web: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed; the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
verses.en_bbe: My dove, my very beautiful one, is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the dearest one of her who gave her birth. The daughters saw her, and gave her a blessing; yes, the queens and the servant-wives, and they gave her praises.

verses.en: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
verses.pt: Quem é esta, que aparece como o nascer do dia, bela como a lua, brilhante como o sol, formidável como bandeiras de exércitos?
verses.en_web: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?
verses.en_bbe: Who is she, looking down as the morning light, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, who is to be feared like an army with flags?

verses.en: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
verses.pt: Desci ao jardim das nogueiras, para ver os frutos do vale; para ver se as videiras estavam floridas, e se as romãzeiras brotavam.
verses.en_web: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.
verses.en_bbe: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the green plants of the valley, and to see if the vine was in bud, and the pomegranate-trees were in flower.

verses.en: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
verses.pt: Sem eu perceber, minha alma me pôs nas carruagens de meu nobre povo.
verses.en_web: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.
verses.en_bbe: Before I was conscious of it, ...

verses.en: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
verses.pt: Moças: Volta! Volta, Sulamita! Volta! Volta, e nós te veremos! Ele: Por que quereis ver a Sulamita, como a dança de duas companhias?
verses.en_web: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?
verses.en_bbe: Come back, come back, O Shulammite; come back, come back, so that our eyes may see you. What will you see in the Shulammite? A sword-dance.
